answers.intended_test_operation: After operator fixture sign-off, repeatedly command true AC OFF, confirm actual loss, wait the approved dwell, restore AC, verify power/POST/BMC/OS milestones, run the complete identity and health validator, write evidence outside the SUT, and increment the completed-cycle counter only for an owner-defined successful state until cycle 1000 is completed within the campaign.
answers.actions_requiring_authorization: Fixture installation and arming; every automated physical AC toggle in the approved campaign; maintenance outage, workload/data isolation, and use of the exact state machine; retry/resume decisions after faults; physical intervention; and any repair, reboot, count adjustment, or recovery outside the approved flow.
answers.evidence_required: Fixture qualification and approvals; immutable schedule/profile; state transitions and timestamps for cycles 1 through 1000; proof of actual AC loss/restoration; boot/POST/OOB/OS results; full per-cycle identity diffs; incremental BMC/SEL/kernel/OS error evidence; retry/failure ledger; health and data-integrity checks; final inventory; and restored nominal state.
answers.stop_conditions: Stop or do not arm for unsafe load/wiring/fixture/interlock, wrong outlet/SUT, failed emergency stop, missing approval, lost external evidence or time sync, failed AC-state confirmation, boot/POST/OS timeout, hang/BSOD, changed device identity, prohibited BMC/kernel/storage/GPU/network error, data-integrity fault, thermal/power issue, management loss, or schedule/count inconsistency.
answers.completion_definition: Exactly 1000 owner-defined completed AC cycles are accounted for within the approved 48-hour campaign, with no skipped or silently retried cycles, complete external evidence for every transition and health check, full-population identity preserved, final nominal power and configuration restored, and unresolved faults dispositioned. Final PASS remains an engineer/end-user decision.
answers.engineer_judgment_remaining: Qualified personnel must approve electrical safety, timing, success and retry semantics, allowable events, staffing, and recovery; determine the disposition of any failed or interrupted cycle; decide whether the campaign may resume; and assign the final result.
